source_text:
1.4 Πρὸς τομὴν πληγέντοσ Ἐπεὶ πολλοὶ πρὸς
τὰς ἀναγκαίας ἀπὸ σιδήρου θεραπείας εἰσὶ δειλοί, φοβούμενοι μᾶλλον τὴν ἀπὸ τῆς
ἰάσεως ἀλγηδόνα τοῦ μέλλοντος ἐκ τοῦ μὴ θεραπευθῆναι βλάβους, φέρε πως
παραμυθησώμεθα τὸν τῆς ὀδύνης ὄκνον, εὐθαρσεστέρους τοὺς κάμνοντας εἰς τὸ
ὑποστῆναι τὴν ἴασιν καθιστάντες. Κούφην ἐχέτω ὁ ἰώμενος χεῖρα, ἵνα εὐκόλως τὴν
τομὴν ἐπιδράμῃ, ὀξεῖαν δὲ φερέτω τὴν ἀκμήν· ὀδυνηρὸν γὰρ ἡ ἀμβλύτης. Εὐτρεπὴς
δὲ ἐς πάντα ὢν ὁ βοηθῶν, καὶ ἐπιπασάτω τῇ πλίνθῳ ἥπερ ἐν πεντα γώνῳ δʹ κεῖται, ᾧ
κατὰ τὸ πυραμοειδὲς ἔγκειται σημεῖα λέξεώς τε καὶ κρούσεως ὑπάτων ἐναρμονίου,
ἄλφα ὕπτιον καὶ γάμμα ἀπεστραμμένον ὄπισθεν γραμμὴν ἔχον.
pass_a_gloss: Toward-cutting of one-struck. Since many toward the necessary treatments from iron are cowardly, fearing more the pain-from-the-healing than the coming harm out-of not-being-treated, come let-us-comfort the hesitation of the pain, setting the sufferers more-confident toward standing-under the healing. Light let the healer have a hand, in-order-that easily he may-run the cut, and sharp let-him-bring the edge; for painful is bluntness. Ready-for-all-things being the helper, let-him-also-sprinkle with the brick which in pentagon 4 lies, in-which according-to the pyramid-shape are-laid signs of speech and of striking of the high enharmonic: inverted alpha and a turned-back gamma having a line behind.
pass_b_english: For the cutting of one who has been struck. Since many are cowardly toward the necessary treatments from iron, fearing the pain from the healing more than the coming harm from not being treated, come, let us somehow comfort the hesitation of the pain, making the sufferers more confident to endure the healing.

Let the healer have a light hand, so that he may run the cut easily, and let him bring a sharp edge; for bluntness is painful. The helper, being ready for all things, must also sprinkle with the brick which lies in pentagon 4, in which, according to the pyramid-shape, are laid signs of speech and of striking of the high enharmonic: an inverted alpha and a turned-back gamma having a line behind.

choices.english: let him also sprinkle with the brick
choices.why: ἐπιπάσσω is sprinkle-on; πλίνθος is the pentagon-coded substance, not a building-brick pressed on the wound.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
